title: Whiteboard
simplified_paragraphs: 有个老师进了教室，在白板上画了一个黑点。他问学生：“这是什么？”大家都回答：“一个黑点。”老师说：“只有一个黑点吗？这么大的白板大家都没有看见吗？”
你看到的是什么呢？每个人都有一些缺点，但是也一定会有很多的优点。换一个角度去看吧！你会有更多新的发现。
traditional_paragraphs: 有個老師進了教室，在白板上畫了一個黑點。他問學生：“這是什麼？”大家都回答：“一個黑點。”老師說：“只有一個黑點嗎？這麼大的白板大家都沒有看見嗎？”
你看到的是什麼呢？每個人都有一些缺點，但是也一定會有很多的優點。換一個角度去看吧！你會有更多新的發現。
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu gè lǎo shī jìn le jiào shì， zài bái bǎn shàng huà le yī gè hēi diǎn。 tā wèn xué shēng：“ zhè shì shén me？” dà jiā dōu huí dá：“ yī gè hēi diǎn。” lǎo shī shuō：“ zhǐ yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn ma？ zhè me dà de bái bǎn dà jiā dōu méi yǒu kàn jiàn ma？”
nǐ kàn dào de shì shén me ne？ měi gè rén dōu yǒu yī xiē quē diǎn， dàn shì yě yī dìng huì yǒu hěn duō de yōu diǎn。 huàn yī gè jiǎo dù qù kàn ba！ nǐ huì yǒu gèng duō xīn de fā xiàn。
english_paragraphs: A teacher walked into the classroom and drew a black dot on the whiteboard. He asked the students, “What is this?” Everyone answered, “A black dot.” The teacher said, “Is that all you see? Didn’t anyone notice this big whiteboard?”
What do you see? Everyone has some shortcomings, but everyone also has many strengths. Try looking from a different angle! You’ll discover many new things.
english_full:
A teacher walked into the classroom and drew a black dot on the whiteboard. He asked the students, “What is this?” Everyone answered, “A black dot.” The teacher said, “Is that all you see? Didn’t anyone notice this big whiteboard?”

What do you see? Everyone has some shortcomings, but everyone also has many strengths. Try looking from a different angle! You’ll discover many new things.
